# Skype
> Skype.com now directs users to Microsoft Teams Free for online meetings, video calls, chat, and lightweight collaboration.

Skype’s consumer calling and messaging experience has been repositioned under Microsoft Teams Free. The site emphasizes instant video meetings, meeting links, chat, file sharing, live captions, and cross-device access, with support and policy resources hosted on Microsoft domains.

## Product Overview
- [Free Online Meetings & Video Calls](https://www.skype.com/): Landing page for Teams Free video calls, chat, file sharing, and collaboration features.
- [Microsoft Teams Free Help](https://support.microsoft.com/office/microsoft-teams-free-help-08fd2b61-1c3e-47e2-821b-d312709b933d): Official help hub for using Teams Free features and troubleshooting common issues.
- [Microsoft Teams](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-teams/): Main Microsoft Teams product page covering plans, features, and platform capabilities.
- [Microsoft Teams Free](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-teams/free): Overview of the free Teams offering for personal and lightweight group communication.

## Meetings and Calling
- [Free Online Meetings & Video Calls](https://www.skype.com/): Start instant meetings, join by link, and host free video calls.
- [Microsoft Teams Free](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-teams/free): Describes free meeting limits, calling options, and collaboration basics.
- [Join with a Meeting ID](https://www.skype.com/): Homepage section highlighting meeting access using a meeting ID.
- [Share Meeting Links](https://www.skype.com/): Homepage section focused on sharing meeting links across devices.
- [Live Captions](https://www.skype.com/): Homepage section describing caption support during meetings and calls.

## Chat and Collaboration
- [Free Online Meetings & Video Calls](https://www.skype.com/): Highlights chat, file sharing, collaboration tools, and conversation continuity in Teams.
- [Microsoft Teams Free Help](https://support.microsoft.com/office/microsoft-teams-free-help-08fd2b61-1c3e-47e2-821b-d312709b933d): Support content for chat, messaging, files, and collaboration workflows.
- [Microsoft Teams](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-teams/): Product information for chat, channels, meetings, and collaborative work features.
- [Microsoft Teams Free](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-teams/free): Free-tier collaboration capabilities for individuals, families, and small groups.

## Getting Started
- [Free Online Meetings & Video Calls](https://www.skype.com/): Entry point for starting free calls and exploring Teams Free.
- [Microsoft Teams Free](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-teams/free): Sign-up and product overview for getting started with the free plan.
- [Microsoft Teams Free Help](https://support.microsoft.com/office/microsoft-teams-free-help-08fd2b61-1c3e-47e2-821b-d312709b933d): Setup guidance, onboarding help, and answers for new users.
- [Microsoft Teams](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-teams/): Broader Teams entry point for comparing free and paid experiences.

## Support
- [Microsoft Teams Free Help](https://support.microsoft.com/office/microsoft-teams-free-help-08fd2b61-1c3e-47e2-821b-d312709b933d): Primary support resource for Teams Free usage, setup, and troubleshooting.
- [Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/): Microsoft’s central support portal for products, accounts, and service issues.
- [Microsoft Teams Support](https://support.microsoft.com/teams): Support landing page for Teams help articles and troubleshooting resources.
- [Microsoft Community](https://answers.microsoft.com/): Community forum for Microsoft product questions and peer support.

## Privacy and Legal
- [Your Privacy Choices](https://aka.ms/yourcaliforniaprivacychoices): Privacy choices information for eligible users under Microsoft privacy policies.
- [Consumer Health Privacy](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2259814): Microsoft consumer health privacy notice and related disclosures.
- [Manage Cookies](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=521839): Cookie management and privacy information for Microsoft web properties.
- [Privacy & Cookies](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=521839): Microsoft privacy statement and cookie practices.
- [Terms of Use](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=206977): Legal terms governing use of Microsoft websites and services.
- [Trademarks](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2196228): Microsoft trademark guidance and intellectual property information.

## Microsoft Ecosystem
- [Microsoft Teams](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-teams/): Core collaboration platform that now anchors the Skype.com experience.
- [Microsoft Teams Free](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-teams/free): Free consumer and small-group offering for meetings, chat, and sharing.
- [Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/): Central support destination for Microsoft products and services.
- [Microsoft](https://www.microsoft.com/): Corporate homepage for Microsoft products, services, and company information.
